title: 第11章 埋伏刺杀第12章 事后惊动
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 方云逸的嘴角，缓缓勾起一抹冰冷而凌厉的笑意。烛火映照下，他那张苍白的脸，竟平添了几分肃杀之气。
三年前，当他初步掌握剑塔之力，身体状况稍稳后，便开始暗中布局。
他利用祖母交给他的、为数不多的月例银子，以及偶尔变卖一些府中不起眼的旧物所得，通过府内的老卒、秘密收养了一批因战乱或饥荒流落街头的孤儿少年。
这些人被安置在京都几个隐蔽的据点，由那些对方家忠心耿耿、从战场上伤残退下来的老卒秘密训练。
他们学习潜行、追踪、刺探，甚至一些军中武艺，成为了方云逸埋在京都阴影下的眼睛和耳朵。
这只信鸽，便是联络方式之一。
“机会来了。”方云逸低声自语。
赵峰心胸狭窄，嚣张跋扈，今日在方府那般折辱祖母与他，方云逸早已将其列入必杀名单。
更何况，是毒蛇就要露出毒牙，总不能一直冬眠在洞内。也是时候，让沉寂多年的京都泛起一丝涟漪。
只有让京都乱起来，或者让整个大乾皇朝都乱起来，才能让自己于乱中寻到机会，从而让方府脱离如今的困境。
他站起身，走到书架后一个隐蔽的角落。那里看似是墙壁，实则有一处暗格。
方云逸轻轻一推，暗格滑开，里面挂着一套毫无光泽的黑色夜行衣，以及一把长约两尺、样式古朴的连鞘短剑。
换上夜行衣后，将短剑悬于腰间。方云逸深吸一口气，体内《紫霄剑经》悄然运转，一股精纯紫色元气在经脉中流淌，将他周身气息彻底收敛，整个人仿佛与周围阴影融为一体。
接着推开藏书楼的后窗，如同一片落叶般悄无声息地滑入夜色之中，身形几个起落，便已消失在方府的高墙之外。
他早已对京都的街道了如指掌，尤其是那些偏僻、昏暗的巷弄。选择了一条从烟花之地返回东城林府的必经之路——乌鸦巷。
这条巷子狭窄而曲折，两侧是高耸的宅院后墙，夜间少有行人，且因为位置偏离主干道，宵禁后巡逻的城卫军经过的间隔时间较长，是埋伏的理想地点。
方云逸如同一只灵猫，在屋顶与阴影间穿梭，速度极快，却未发出丝毫声响。
不久，他便来到乌鸦巷中段一处最佳的伏击点，一个空置的宅院门楼阴影下。
这里视野开阔，可以观察到巷子两头的情况，且门楼的阴影足以完美隐藏他的身形。
他收敛全身气息，如同石雕般静静潜伏下来，唯有那双在黑暗中熠熠生辉的眸子，冷静地注视着巷口的方向，等待着猎物的出现。
时间一点点过去，夜风带着寒意吹过空巷，卷起几片落叶。远处隐约传来更夫敲梆子的声音，已是二更天。
终于，巷口传来踉跄的脚步声和含糊不清的哼唱声。只见赵峰满脸醉意，步履蹒跚地走了过来。
他衣衫略显凌乱，脸上带着满足而**的笑容，显然刚从温柔乡中尽兴而归。
他一边走着，似乎还在回味着方才的美妙滋味，嘴里嘟囔着。
“嘿……京都的小娘子……就是比山下的水灵……等明日，再去……呃……”
话未说完，便打了个响亮的酒嗝。
他丝毫没有察觉到，黑暗中，一双冰冷的眼睛已经锁定了他。
死亡的气息，如同潮水般，随着他的脚步，悄然弥漫在这条昏暗的巷道之中。
content_en:
The corner of Fang Yunyi's mouth slowly lifted into a cold and sharp smile. Under the candlelight, his pale face actually gained a bit of a chilling air.
Three years ago, when he initially mastered the power of the sword tower and his physical condition stabilized, he began to secretly plan.
He used the small amount of monthly money given to him by his grandmother, as well as the income from occasionally selling some inconspicuous old things in the mansion, to secretly adopt a group of orphans and teenagers who had been living on the streets due to war or famine through the old soldiers in the mansion.
These people were placed in several hidden strongholds in Kyoto and were secretly trained by veteran soldiers who were loyal to the other side and retired from the battlefield with disabilities.
They learned stealth, tracking, espionage, and even some military martial arts, and became Fang Yunyi's eyes and ears buried in the shadow of Kyoto.
This homing pigeon is one of the contact methods.
"The opportunity has come." Fang Yunyi whispered to himself.
Zhao Feng was narrow-minded, arrogant and domineering. He humiliated his grandmother and him like that in Fang Mansion today. Fang Yunyi had already put him on the must-kill list.
What's more, a venomous snake has to show its fangs and cannot hibernate in a cave forever. It is also time for a ripple to appear in Kyoto, which has been silent for many years.
Only by causing chaos in Kyoto, or the entire Daqian Dynasty, can we find opportunities in the chaos and get Fang Mansion out of its current predicament.
He stood up and walked to a hidden corner behind the bookshelf. It looks like a wall, but in fact there is a hidden compartment.
Fang Yunyi pushed gently, and the secret compartment slid open. Hanging inside was a set of matte black night clothes and a simple sheathed dagger about two feet long.
After putting on his night clothes, he hung his dagger on his waist. Fang Yunyi took a deep breath, and the "Purple Sky Sword Sutra" quietly circulated in his body. A stream of pure purple energy flowed through his meridians, completely restraining the aura around him, and his whole body seemed to be integrated with the surrounding shadows.
Then he opened the back window of the library and slipped into the night as quietly as a fallen leaf. After a few ups and downs, he disappeared outside the high wall of Fang Mansion.
He already knew the streets of Kyoto very well, especially the remote and dark alleys. He chose the only way to return to Dongcheng Lin Mansion from the land of fireworks - Crow Alley.
This alley is narrow and winding, with towering back walls of houses on both sides. There are few pedestrians at night, and because it is located away from the main road, the city guards patrolling after curfew pass by at long intervals, making it an ideal place for an ambush.
Fang Yunyi was like a civet cat, shuttling between roofs and shadows at extremely fast speeds without making any sound.
Soon, he came to the best ambush spot in the middle of Crow Alley, under the shadow of an empty gatehouse.
The view here is wide, and you can observe the situation at both ends of the alley, and the shadow of the gatehouse is enough to perfectly hide his figure.
He restrained his aura and lurked quietly like a stone sculpture. Only his eyes shining in the darkness calmly stared in the direction of the alley, waiting for the prey to appear.
Time passed little by little, and the night wind blew through the empty alley with a chill, picking up a few fallen leaves. The sound of the watchman banging his wooden clapper could be heard faintly in the distance. It was already the second watch.
Finally, the sound of staggering footsteps and vague humming came from the alley. Zhao Feng was seen walking over drunkenly.
His clothes were slightly disheveled, and he had a satisfied and happy smile on his face. It was obvious that he had just returned from the gentle country.
As he walked, he seemed to be still savoring the wonderful taste just now, mumbling in his mouth.
"Hey... the little lady from Kyoto... is the water spirit at the foot of Bishan... wait until tomorrow, then go... uh..."
Before he finished speaking, he let out a loud wine burp.
He didn't realize at all that in the darkness, a pair of cold eyes had locked onto him.
The breath of death, like a tide, quietly filled this dark alleyway with his footsteps.
